name: Basilica and National Shrine of Our Lady of Consolation
history: Devotion to Our Lady of Consolation came to Carey from Luxembourg; a statue commissioned for the parish arrived from there in 1875. Bishop Joseph Schrembs of Toledo later invited the Conventual Franciscans to run the shrine, which they still do. Pope Paul VI named it a minor basilica in 1971.
arch: The shrine complex keeps the original 1875 wooden parish church beside the larger basilica, along with a friary, retreat house and pilgrim facilities.
features: The statue of Our Lady of Consolation came from Luxembourg in 1875.
Each August, for the Assumption, pilgrims come here, many of them Catholics from Middle Eastern communities.

look.d: Two front towers mark the basilica above the small town.
The facade's round window sits above the entrance used by thousands of pilgrims every August.

fun: The basilica's papal decree, Quam Prope Assit, was issued on 21 October 1971.
journal: A small Ohio town and a Luxembourg Madonna. Pilgrims in August, Franciscans all year.
